title: Sign skeletons
description: Skeletons that drawings are matched against, traced over one font. See docs/skeleton-format.md.

font.description: The font the skeletons were traced over.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 hash of the font file, in lowercase hex.

credit.description: The attribution the app must show when it uses this file.

comments.description: Notes on the file: who or what made it, and when.

wedges.description: Whether the font's wedges have a head then a tail, or taper over their whole length.

headAspect.description: A wedge head's depth divided by its size, in a headed font.

headLean.description: The angle of a wedge head's back edge from square to its tail, in degrees, anticlockwise.

winkelhakenAngle.description: The angle between a Winkelhaken's legs, in degrees.

text.description: The characters the font draws as this glyph: one or more code points, each cuneiform or private-use.

shapes.description: The shapes, one string each, in the order docs/skeleton-format.md defines.

comments.description: Notes on this entry, for people editing the file.
